title: The Aeroplane, 13 Feb 1948, p.187: Huth biplane and Cedric Lee monoplane (Figs. 6-7)
description: Continuation page of the article on low aspect ratio aircraft in The Aeroplane. It includes line drawings captioned "Fig. 6.—Huth annular biplane of 1909" and "Fig. 7.—Cedric Lee Monoplane No. 1 of Tilghman Richards, 1912", the latter shown in front and plan views. The text recounts early British ring-wing aircraft experiments and ends "(To be continued.)".
